name: Vago
tagline: One number a day: how much of your screen time was work.
summary: An AI-native focus app that counts work and scrolling across your iPhone and Mac.

highlights.label: SHARE
highlights.title: Productive share, not screen time
highlights.text: 100% minus procrastination, in the Mac menu bar and on Today.

highlights.label: AI
highlights.title: On-device work or waste
highlights.text: The Mac judges titles and URLs against your goals. Nothing leaves it.

highlights.label: CORRECT
highlights.title: One tap fixes a call
highlights.text: A correction becomes a rule; Vago holds back when you overrule it.

highlights.label: LIMIT
highlights.title: A daily limit that shrinks
highlights.text: The waste limit walks down to 30 minutes.

highlights.label: GUARD
highlights.title: Pause cards and shields
highlights.text: Mac guards up to three places; iPhone asks "Work or scroll?".

highlights.label: FOCUS
highlights.title: Grow a tree, keep the day
highlights.text: 25 or 50 minute sessions shield distracting apps.

steps.title: Count
steps.text: Mac and iPhone log work and waste.

steps.title: Correct
steps.text: One tap turns a call into a rule.

steps.title: Share
steps.text: One number a day, on every device.
